## JobOS Scheduled Search Runner

This workflow is ONLY the external clock. It calls JobOS's own
`POST /api/scheduler/run-due`, which itself decides which saved
searches are due (scripts/scheduler.py) and triggers them through the
EXISTING search_store.trigger_run() -> search worker pipeline. This
workflow never implements scheduling rules, never touches SQLite
directly, and never picks which searches run.

**Two separate API instances exist -- point this workflow at the
right one:**
- Dev API (`127.0.0.1:8420`, jobos_dev.db) -- for interactive
  development only, NOT real automation data.
- Production/automation API (`127.0.0.1:8421`, jobos.db) -- started
  with `scripts/run_production_api.py`; this is what real recurring
  automation should point at.

**Before activating:**
1. Open the "JobOS Config" node and set `jobos_base_url` to
   `http://host.docker.internal:8421` (default, since n8n runs in
   Docker and 8421 is the production/automation API -- see
   docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's "Scheduling" section). Never `localhost`
   from inside the container -- it won't reach the Mac host.
2. Pick an interval on the Schedule Trigger (default: every 30
   minutes). This only needs to be more frequent than your fastest
   configured schedule frequency (hourly/daily/weekly) -- calling
   run-due when nothing is due is a harmless no-op.
3. Do not also run scripts/run_scheduled_searches.py via cron/launchd
   at the same time -- pick ONE external trigger.

No application is ever submitted by this workflow -- it only starts
discovery/scoring runs, exactly like clicking "Run now" in the UI.
